description: This file implements a fatal error handler for the SPARC architecture in Zephyr RTOS, including debug functions for printing register states and trap information.

methods.name: print_trap_type
methods.description: Prints the trap type based on the trap register value.

methods.name: print_integer_registers
methods.description: Prints the integer register values and register windows.

methods.name: print_special_registers
methods.description: Prints special registers like psr, wim, tbr, y, pc, and npc.

methods.name: print_backtrace
methods.description: Prints a backtrace of the call stack based on saved register frames.

methods.name: print_all
methods.description: Calls all print functions to output full register and trap info.

methods.name: z_sparc_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by printing debug info and halting execution.
